task.description:
WF-03 Step 4 for ISS-0896. The fixed code (5 e2e Playwright specs) cannot be run live in this environment (no browser/backend/Keycloak) -- but the NEW shared helper this fix introduces, getMasterAdminToken(request: APIRequestContext) in web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts, has genuinely unit-testable logic: it must call resolveCredential for username/password (env var if set, 'admin'/'admin' fallback if not), POST a fixed client_id: 'admin-cli' form body to the master token endpoint via the injected request object, and throw on a non-2xx response. Write a real vitest unit test at web/tests/unit/e2e-helpers/get-master-admin-token.test.ts (new directory, or reuse an existing web/tests/unit subdirectory if one already tests web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts -- check first) that mocks APIRequestContext.post (a fake object with a post method returning a controllable {ok, status, json} shape, no real network) and asserts: (1) with KC_ADMIN_USER/KC_ADMIN_PASSWORD unset, the POST body's username/password are 'admin'/'admin'; (2) with both env vars set, the POST body's username/password match the env values, not the fallback; (3) on a non-ok response, the function throws (and the thrown error does not itself leak the attempted username/password in its message, matching SECURITY-REVIEWER's own PASS finding); (4) on an ok response, the function returns the access_token from the JSON body.

Because getMasterAdminToken is a NEW function (no pre-fix version existed to run the test against -- WF-03's own 'pre-fix failure is non-existence' rule applies), the fail-then-pass proof must come from MUTATION rather than a literal pre-fix/post-fix run: apply at least 2 targeted mutants to the shipped helper (e.g. mutant A: hardcode username/password back to literal 'admin'/'admin' ignoring resolveCredential entirely -- must fail test (2); mutant B: remove the throw-on-non-ok check -- must fail test (3)), run the test suite against each mutant, record which specific tests fail for each, then revert every mutation and verify `git status --porcelain web/` is empty and the suite re-runs green. State this all explicitly in result.summary per WF-03's mutation-testing procedure (see docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md's 'When the pre-fix failure is code under test does not exist' section -- artifacts_in intentionally does not repeat it here, read it there). Use a throwaway git worktree for applying mutants if you can, to avoid mutating the working checkout at all; otherwise revert in place and verify.
acceptance_criteria: a real, runnable vitest unit test exists for getMasterAdminToken covering the 4 behaviors listed above
at least 2 targeted mutants were applied and each one's specific test failure(s) recorded
every mutation was reverted and the revert verified (git status --porcelain web/ empty, suite re-runs green) before this handoff completes
the thrown-error-on-failure path is confirmed not to leak the attempted credential value in its message
